classification_vocabulary.FRESH: observed in this r13x read-only work package
classification_vocabulary.REUSED_EXACT_IDENTITY: pre-existing evidence bound to the exact r13x candidate identity
classification_vocabulary.HISTORICAL_CONTEXT_ONLY: older-candidate evidence used only to understand method or failure, never re-labelled as r13x
classification_vocabulary.PENDING_OTHER_WORK_PACKAGE: required result is owned by another current r13x work package and was not observed here
classification_vocabulary.BLOCKED: a known dependency or authority is absent
